description: Unique internal identifier for the bank branch.
Business code assigned to the bank branch.
Display name of the bank branch.
Geographic region used to group branches for reporting.
City in which the branch is located.
State or territory in which the branch is located.
Postal code for the branch location.
Current operating status of the branch.
Unique internal identifier for the bank officer.
Business code assigned to the bank officer.
Full name of the bank officer.
Identifier of the branch to which the officer is assigned.
Business role performed by the officer.
Work email address recorded for the officer.
Current employment or activity status of the officer.
Unique internal identifier for the banking product.
Business code used to identify the banking product.
Display name of the banking product.
Category of the banking product such as savings, current account, fixed deposit, or loan.
ISO-style currency code in which the product is denominated.
Configured annual interest rate associated with the product.
Minimum balance requirement configured for the product.
Current availability or lifecycle status of the product.
Unique internal identifier assigned to a customer.
Customer category indicating whether the customer is a person or a business.
First name recorded for an individual customer.
Last name recorded for an individual customer.
Registered or trading name recorded for a business customer.
Tax identifier recorded for the customer.
Date of birth recorded for an individual customer.
Primary contact email address recorded for the customer.
Primary contact telephone number recorded for the customer.
Primary street address line recorded for the customer.
City recorded as part of the customer address.
State or territory recorded as part of the customer address.
Postal code recorded as part of the customer address.
Country recorded as part of the customer address.
Identifier of the home or servicing branch associated with the customer.
Identifier of the relationship officer associated with the customer.
Current lifecycle status of the customer relationship.
Date on which the customer record was created in the source system.
Timestamp of the most recent source update to the customer record.
Vendor-supplied customer reference value used for source reconciliation.
Free-form customer servicing or operational notes.
Unique internal identifier for the deposit account.
Customer-facing account number assigned to the deposit account.
Identifier of the customer who owns the account.
Identifier of the banking product associated with the account.
Identifier of the branch associated with the account.
Date on which the account was opened.
Date on which the account was closed, when applicable.
Current lifecycle status of the account.
Currency code in which the account is denominated.
Current recorded monetary balance of the account.
Business type of the deposit account derived from its product.
Identifier of the deposit account for which the daily balance is recorded.
Business date to which the daily balance record applies.
Account balance at the beginning of the business date.
Account balance at the end of the business date.
Balance available for customer use at the end of the business date.
Currency code of the recorded balances.
Source system that produced the daily balance record.
Timestamp at which the daily balance record was loaded into RAW.
Unique internal identifier for the synthetic payment card.
Identifier of the account to which the card is linked.
Identifier of the customer associated with the card.
Synthetic payment card number associated with the card record.
Type of card, such as debit or credit.
Date on which the card was issued.
Date on which the card is scheduled to expire.
Current lifecycle status of the card.
Unique internal identifier for the loan.
Business-facing loan number assigned to the facility.
Identifier of the customer who holds the loan.
Identifier of the loan product associated with the facility.
Identifier of the branch responsible for the loan.
Identifier of the officer responsible for the loan relationship.
Business type of the loan derived from the associated product.
Original principal amount of the loan.
Current unpaid principal or exposure amount for the loan.
Annual interest rate applied to the loan.
Contractual duration of the loan in months.
Date on which the loan commenced.
Contractual maturity date of the loan.
Credit grade assigned to the loan or borrower for risk assessment.
Current lifecycle or repayment status of the loan.
Unique internal identifier for a collateral item.
Identifier of the loan secured by the collateral item.
Category of collateral securing the loan.
Business description of the collateral item.
Latest recorded monetary valuation of the collateral item.
Date on which the collateral valuation was performed.
Name of the recorded owner of the collateral item.
Current lifecycle or eligibility status of the collateral item.
Unique identifier for the general-ledger control total record.
Business date to which the control total applies.
General-ledger account code represented by the control total.
Product grouping represented by the control total.
Currency code of the control total.
General-ledger control balance used to reconcile deposit balances.
Count of source transactions contributing to the control population.
Source system that produced the general-ledger control record.
Timestamp at which the control record was loaded into RAW.
Unique identifier for an account transaction posting.
Identifier of the account affected by the transaction.
Identifier of the customer associated with the transaction account.
Date on which the transaction occurred.
Date on which the transaction was posted to the account.
Business classification of the transaction event.
Source or business code identifying the transaction type.
Monetary amount of the transaction posting.
Currency code of the transaction amount.
Indicator specifying whether the posting is a debit or a credit.
Channel through which the transaction was initiated.
Merchant or counterparty display name associated with the transaction, when applicable.
Current processing status of the transaction.
External or source reference associated with the transaction.
Free-form transaction memo supplied by the source system.
Account balance immediately after the transaction posting.
Timestamp at which the transaction record was loaded into RAW.
Identifier used to group related postings belonging to one logical transaction.
